title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Is it permissible in Islam to invest in mutual funds? 22317 views Q. I have gone through the previous fatwas of Dar-ul-Ifta about the investment in stock market. I have come to know now that I have to invest in which type of companies. But my question is related to my previous investments. I have already invested in some on the companies which are not fulfilling sharia complaince criteria. I obviously have to get rid of such companies and I have to sell the shares of such companies. But will the profit I will get will be haram? As i didnt knew before this criteria of sharia compliance. Some of the companies in which I have invested I am getting profit and in some loss at this time but profit is more than loss. Please advise about such profit. Regards, Rana Khawar 5416 views Q. Investments in well known Indian companies 6824 views Q. I am a day trader of stocks. Is it permissible to short sell in Islam Short selling is the selling of a stock that the seller doesn't own at the time of selling them. He sells them in the hope that the price of those shares will decline, and he will profit by buying back those shares at a lower price. Waiting for your reply. 13965 views Q. Assalamualeyikum, Are we muslims (Allowed) to invest in share market. E.g. I am planning to buy shared for IT Companies like HCL, Wipro, or Reliance. What all shares we (Muslims) can buy and what all shares we can't buy Jazaakumullah! 11238 views Q. INVESTMENT 4426 views Q. Assalamalaikum mufti saheb, One of my cousin want to help my aged uncle by giving money to perform haj. But he clearly says that he is working in a bank and the money is earned through his salary and by investing in shares.Is it jayez for my aged uncle to perform haj pilgrimage using his money? My uncle is very poor. Kindly advise as per shariyath. 3270 views Q. Is participating in Star-capital finance investment company halal 2376 views Q. I want to save my tax?what can be the the ways permitted by shariat?can i put my money into the mutual funds which are putting the money from investers to banking,finance(loans etc),media and entertainment,although the percentage of above these sectors where the money is invested is less than 10 %?kindly guide me. 5092 views Q. Business 2753 views Q. Investment and intrest 6414 views Q. Shares legal possession - digital contract note 5231 views Q. regarding share trading i learnt that trading shares of those companies which do not indulge in unlawful business like wine company etc is permissible. But even if we invest in companies which do not have these haram products or services, like real estate, IT, power companies, they are involved in interest based financing for their projects and ventures. Investing in them will mean partnership in a company that's financed by haram means. Please, guide whether such investments are halal . 5273 views Q. I want to work in National Stock Exchange, Mumbai. Is stock exchange work halal or haram ( Stock exchange works Shares business Buying shares and selling shares ) please answer immediately to my email. 6842 views Q. Salam Alaykum, I used to do investment in Mutual funds wherein when the sensex goes up I used to get fund value high and when the sensex goes down I use to get fund value low. The fund value is the value which I am supposed to withdraw. For example If I invested for an amount of Rs. 5000. Based on the market condition I will be having this amount either 4000 or 6000 and can go higher or lower. Kindly let me know is this a genuine by Islam. 6464 views
answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Shares & Investments Question ID: 4052 Country: India Title: Please answer my followingh query 1)Is a Franchaisee or a Sub-Broker Is it permissible for me to take commission for future and options and Daily trading ( Intra Day Trading) and Delivery based shares from Muslim and non Muslim customers. 2) The Franchaisee is termed as a service provider media by Parsoli Corp. Is the commission Jaaiz for the Franchaisee or Sub-Broker to buy and sell shares of Non-Sharia companies ( Not allowed by Shariat ) for anyone. 3) Is the commission Jaaiz to buy and sell shares of Non-Sharia companies for Non-Muslims as a service provider. 4)If Yes then Does the commission received by the Trade should be given in charity without any reward ?, or Does it require purification. If Yes then how it has to be purified ? 5)Does Tabligh Jamaat Deoband give the Fatwa to go ahead to my questions? I am waiting for your reply soon. Jazaakallahu khaira Mohd.sAJID Question: Assalamualaikum , Please answer my followingh query 1)Is a Franchaisee or a Sub-Broker Is it permissible for me to take commission for future and options and Daily trading ( Intra Day Trading) and Delivery based shares from Muslim and non Muslim customers. 2) The Franchaisee is termed as a service provider media by Parsoli Corp. Is the commission Jaaiz for the Franchaisee or Sub-Broker to buy and sell shares of Non-Sharia companies ( Not allowed by Shariat ) for anyone. 3) Is the commission Jaaiz to buy and sell shares of Non-Sharia companies for Non-Muslims as a service provider. 4)If Yes then Does the commission received by the Trade should be given in charity without any reward ?, or Does it require purification. If Yes then how it has to be purified ? 5)Does Tabligh Jamaat Deoband give the Fatwa to go ahead to my questions? I am waiting for your reply soon. Jazaakallahu khaira Mohd.sAJID Answer ID: 4052 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 768/636B) Please, clarify the question and write detailed procedure. Who are sub-brokers and what they do? What are non-Sharia companies, who own them and what do these companies do? When and how they distribute the profit? Please, explain these matters then only we can have a say. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
